designationHistory.indexText: Lake Ophelia National Wildlife Refuge was established in October 2000 with the purpose of conserving and restoring habitat for migratory birds, aquatic resources, and endangered plants and animals.
designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.
